test_case.name: Node Memory Pressure & Kubelet Pod Eviction
test_case.scenario_description: Worker node 'node-worker-07' runs critically low on host memory (available RAM drops to 42Mi, below the 100Mi eviction hard threshold). Kubelet transitions node condition 'MemoryPressure' to True and invokes the eviction manager to evict Burstable pod 'analytics-aggregator-59b7c4d8e-v6r2t' (container 'spark-executor', namespace 'data-pipeline').
test_case.injected_fault: Host node available memory falls below kubelet evictionHard threshold (memory.available<100Mi), triggering NodeCondition MemoryPressure=True and pod eviction.
test_case.ground_truth_rca: Worker node 'node-worker-07' entered MemoryPressure=True when available host memory dropped to 42Mi (below the 100Mi eviction threshold), causing the kubelet eviction manager to evict pod 'analytics-aggregator-59b7c4d8e-v6r2t'.

evidence.highlighted_reason: Resource/Node constraint detected: 'The node was low on resource: memory'

suggested_remediation: Inspect cluster node capacities and allocatable resources: `kubectl describe nodes | grep -A 8 'Allocated resources'`.
Verify pod resource requests and limits (`spec.containers[*].resources`) to ensure they match workload needs and node sizing.
Inspect node memory conditions and eviction events: `kubectl describe node <node-name>`.
Set accurate memory requests equal to limits (Guaranteed QoS) for critical workloads to protect them from node eviction.
Lower excessive pod `resources.requests` to fit within worker node allocatable capacity, or scale out the node pool.
Review namespace ResourceQuota and LimitRange constraints: `kubectl describe quota,limitrange -n <namespace>`.
